EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Even when I have nothing specific in
mind to buy, I end up going to the
convenience store.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hasta cuando no tengo nada
concreto que comprar, siempre
acabo viniendo al mercado.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Même quand je n'ai besoin de rien,
je finis toujours par venir flâner
dans les rayons...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando vengo all'emporio, finisco
sempre per comprare qualcosa
anche se non mi serve nulla.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aklımda alacağım belirli bir şey olmasa
bile dönüp dolaşıp Mini
Market'e geliyorum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}You here on the scout for items
you can incorporate in a fresh
new workout regime?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha! I like it! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}You're always
thinking outside the box, huh,
{{TAG:000E:0006:0600620072006F000E006C00610064007900620072006F00}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Te han entrado ganas de
comprarte alguna cosilla
a estas horas?
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Ja, ja! ¡Cuidado con esas cosas,
tronc{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ¡Yo prefiero ser disciplinado
y seguir los horarios, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Sei qui per comprare qualche
bel mobile massiccio da usare
per il sollevamento pesi?
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ah ah! Beh, certo! I muscoli si
potenziano meglio con dei bei pezzi
d'arredamento,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Yeni antrenman programına katabileceğin
eşyaları keşfe mi çıktın?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha! Hoşuma
gitti! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Hep kalıpların dışında
düşünüyorsun, ha,
{{TAG:000E:0006:0600620072006F000E006C00610064007900620072006F00}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est vachement pratique d'avoir un
commerce du genre ouvert jusque
tard dans la nuit, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'emporio qui è aperto fino a tardi.
Posso allenarmi di giorno e fare
la spesa di notte,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Before you buy something, you
should ask around and gauge
interest just to be safe!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}You don't want to get on someone's
bad side by buying something they
wanted to buy!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}That can be pretty scary!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Antes de comprar algo, ¡a lo mejor
deberías preguntarle a quien viva
en este pueblo por si acaso!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Imagínate qué faena si compras
algo que le interesaba a otra
persona! ¡A ver si acabáis mal!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}No sé, es que siempre es mejor
no llevarse mal si lo puedes
evitar, ¿no crees, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Avant d'acheter quelque chose, il
vaut mieux t'assurer que personne
ne l'avait repéré avant toi.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Crois-moi, tu n'as pas envie de te
faire des ennemis en leur piquant
un article sous le museau !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Prima di comprare qualcosa, è
meglio chiedere in giro se qualcuno
è interessato a fare lo stesso.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Non conviene guadagnarsi un nemico
soffiandogli un articolo da sotto
il naso, proprio no.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Non sarebbe un comportamento
sportivo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bevor du was kaufst, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}solltest du
dich umhören, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}ob vielleicht jemand
anderes Interesse daran hat!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Es könnte ja passieren, dass du
jemandem was vor der Nase
wegkaufst und ihn damit verärgerst.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}So was sieht nicht jeder sportlich!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bir şey almadan önce garanti olsun diye
etrafa sorup kimlerin gözü onda
öğrenmelisin!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bir başkasının almak
istediği şeyi kapıp ters tarafına denk
gelmek istemezsin!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Bayağı korkutucu olabilir!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}After going for a jog, I come to the
convenience store to cool down
before heading back home!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Cuando vuelvo de correr, ¡suelo
pasar por el mercado para estar un
rato tranqui antes de volver a casa!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}J'aime bien passer ici après mon
jogging, ça me rafraîchit les idées
avant de rentrer à la maison !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Dopo la mia corsetta quotidiana,
passo sempre all'emporio per
rilassarmi prima di andare a casa.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Nach 'nem harten Lauftraining geh
ich gern zum Supermarkt, um meine
Beinmuskeln etwas zu lockern!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Koşudan sonra eve dönmeden
önce serinlemek için Mini Market'e uğruyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}After going for a jog, I come to the
convenience store to buy some
stuff before heading back home!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Cuando vuelvo de correr, ¡suelo
venir por el mercado a comprar
algunas cosas antes de ir a casa!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Rien de tel que de faire quelques
emplettes pour se délasser après
un bon jogging !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Dopo la mia corsetta quotidiana,
passo sempre all'emporio
per comprare qualcosina.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Nach 'nem harten Lauftraining
komm ich gern zum Supermarkt,
um mir 'ne Belohnung zu kaufen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Koşudan sonra eve dönmeden önce birkaç
şey almak için Mini Market'e uğruyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I always stop by to check the new
items at the convenience store
when I'm out for a jog.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Cuando salgo a correr siempre
me paso por el mercado a ver los
nuevos objetos por si me interesan.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}À chaque fois que je vais courir un
peu, j'en profite pour venir faire un
tour dans le coin !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Quando esco a correre faccio
sempre un salto all'emporio
per vedere cosa c'è di nuovo.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Nach 'nem harten Lauftraining
komm ich gern zum Supermarkt,
um zu sehen, was es Neues gibt!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Koşuya çıktığımda Mini Market'e uğrayıp
yeni ürünleri mutlaka kontrol ederim.
